tools.name: get_concert
tools.description:
One concert by its id, also past, cancelled or removed ones (see `status`).
`page_url` is the link to give to users: the concert's page on Trisonia,
which also has the ticket link.

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: All venues by name with city, country, region and website (up to 200 per call).

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_concerts" is 1254 chars, far longer than this server's median (180). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
